text:
If you're just checking in on the day, here's where we stand: mostly cloudy, 79 and sticky at 82 with that south wind, and the real action is still ahead of us. The window between 1 and 4 this afternoon is when showers and thunderstorms get most likely, and the Euro's leaning much wetter than the American model on totals, so I'd keep the rain plan flexible rather than trust any one number. High near 85, but this is one of those days you feel the humidity more than the thermometer. On the water, waves stay calm at a foot or less, but with thunder in the mix this afternoon, I'd be off the lake by early afternoon and wait out the noisy stretch.

Showers linger into tonight before a cold front clears us out. Sunday's the payoff, mostly sunny, high near 86, humidity finally backing off, and just a slim shower chance before 9am. Good day to save the big outdoor plans for tomorrow if today's forecast has you hesitant.

week.blurb: Storms ramp up through the afternoon, likely between 1 and 4, so keep the rain plan handy even with some sun peeking through.
Sunday swings mostly sunny and less muggy, with just a brief morning sprinkle chance before things dry out.
Sunshine holds most of the day before evening showers and thunderstorms move in, likely after dark.
Mostly sunny and pleasant with only a slim shot at an afternoon shower.
Morning showers give way to sun, though a stray afternoon storm is still possible.
Showers and thunderstorms look likely again, especially by afternoon, with a cooler high near 79.
Trending drier and breezy to close the week, mostly sunny with just a slight shower chance.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Scattered showers and thunderstorms will continue today, but they will be more widely scattered compared to last night. Severe weather isn’t expected, but there could be locally an inch or more of rain in any thunderstorms with isolated flash flooding not out of the question. A cold front will come through tonight and into Sunday, leaving us with just the chance for a few showers or thunderstorms in the Northeast Kingdom on Sunday. The humidity will be kicked down a notch Sunday afternoon. High temperatures over the weekend will be in the 80s.
